TS '26 Creative Prelims · Path 2 — The Empire
The Problem
The galaxy is scattered.

Order 66 fell. Hundreds of Jedi survive across a thousand worlds — rebuilding, recruiting, learning to vanish.

The Empire has legions — but no eyes.

9 targets10 sectors6 hunters0 coordination
Fragmented Intel
reports filed into a void — no single picture of the galaxy
Isolated Hunters
six Inquisitors, six separate hunts — no shared channel
No Recruit Defense
the Order recruits through refugee networks, unchecked
No Decision Layer
sightings sit in ledgers while targets slip away
OBSIDIAN · Problem02
The Solution
One nervous system.

OBSIDIAN turns a disorganized purge into a single hunting organism — every sector, probe and citizen a sensor in the Emperor's hand.
